name: smwmusic-seven-of-wands-sunset-beach
title: Seven of Wands / Sunset Beach
description:
A new original composition that draws inspiration from Lui's "Hydrothermal Hollow". Features a vivid 7/8 section and a more laid-back B-section. It could be used for cave settings, beach es (preferably) at sunset and more.

Also one of my more conventional songs.
